answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 2 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the shale reference is updated at each glacier checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the reef audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 79 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
